hero_subtitle:
Goo reads the clothes in your camera roll, turns your closet digital,
and suggests the outfit that fits you best — every morning.
features_title:
Here's how Goo
works for you
features_intro: Less time logging, more accuracy in every suggestion. Your morning closet becomes less a storage space and more the assistant who knows you best.
feature1_heading: One photo is all it takes
feature1_desc: Goo automatically analyzes and sorts the clothes in your photos. No manual entry — your wardrobe goes digital on its own.
feature2_desc: Blurry shot or messy background? Goo regenerates it into a clean product image — while keeping try-on quality intact.
feature3_desc: A fashion assistant that has learned the weather, your schedule and your taste suggests the outfit that suits you best, every morning.
feature3_alt: Goo daily recommendation virtual try-on result
how_title:
A smart closet
in just three steps
how_intro:
No complex setup, no tedious data entry.
Open the app, connect your photos — Goo takes it from there.
how_step1_desc: Goo finds the clothes in your photos automatically and sorts them by category. No manual logging — your closet is digitized instantly.
how_step2_desc: Goo learns your go-to combinations, favorite colors and style patterns. The more you use it, the sharper its suggestions get.
how_step3_desc: Goo recommends what to wear based on the weather and your schedule. Preview it with a virtual try-on before you decide.
how_bottom_text: Five minutes to set up. Zero every morning after.
vision_headline: Goo isn't a closet app.It's a fashion data network.
vision_intro: Beyond solving your daily outfit dilemma, Goo is building a new fashion infrastructure that connects people, brands and society. What we're drawing isn't just a better closet.
vision1_title:
Beyond the closet —
a space where users worldwide connect
vision1_desc: It starts with solving what to wear each day, but Goo users go on to form a new network built around clothing. Resale, a fashion creator economy, peer-to-peer style curation — the closet becomes content, and content becomes a marketplace.
vision1_metric: Global fashion C2C market at $200B · growing 15% a year
vision2_title:
Not surveys, but
brands driven by real try-on data
vision2_desc: Goo captures real try-on data on when, where, how and with what users wear a brand's clothing. It turns hyper-targeted marketing, regional trend analysis and brand decisions into something data-driven.
vision2_metric: Fashion data market growing 22% a year · projected to reach $5T by 2030
vision3_title:
Buy less, wear more —
the start of sustainable fashion
vision3_desc: Digitizing the closet leads to fewer duplicate purchases, more clothing reuse and less waste. Starting from personal convenience, Goo proposes a new behavioral infrastructure that shrinks fashion's carbon footprint.
vision3_metric: 92M tonnes of clothing discarded worldwide each year · 8–10% of industrial carbon emissions
vision_quote:
"Digitizing the closet is, in the end,
rewriting the way we dress."
team_intro: A small but solid team makes Goo a little better every day. Every product decision starts right here.
team1_bio: Leads Goo's vision and overall product direction. He works closest to the everyday closet problems our users face.
team2_bio: Designs and builds Goo's technical architecture and its entire AI pipeline. A stable system and a precise recommendation engine start in his hands.
team_hiring_sub: We're looking for someone to write Goo's next chapter with us.
